description: Send Stillleaf a requirement (Memorial program correction, printing and delivery). Your correction and delivery request is recorded and receives a reference number. If no secure link was given, the next step is yours: reply to Stillleaf's first email with the file attached. When the file arrives, Stillleaf reviews it with the correction, resolves open details, and establishes printing and delivery feasibility. We reply by email when you leave an address, with a proposed completion plan and pricing for review. Nothing is ordered or committed until you agree terms; timing and availability are confirmed before acceptance. Contact details are kept apart from the requirement, while we correspond or do business and for 24 months after, so a later request picks up where it left off; ask us to delete them at any time. It is answered with a receipt: keep its id and token to read its status (request_status), to add details later (continuation) and to act on an offer made in reply. A requirement is not an order and costs nothing.

continuation.description: The receipt id and token of an earlier request, to add to it instead of opening a new one

need.description: The requirement in the buyer's own words
